description: Use to compare Poland with the EU: house prices, mortgage rates, bond yields, household electricity and gas prices, and minimum wages. Poland compared with EU countries: "house-prices" (Eurostat house price index), "mortgage-rates" (ECB rates on new housing loans), "bond-yields" (10-year yields and spreads vs Germany and euro area), "overburden" and "overcrowding" (housing conditions), "energy-prices" (household electricity or gas prices per kWh in EUR and purchasing power standards, half-yearly, with finwire_eu_power_price_gap and kWh per minimum wage), "minimum-wages" (statutory minimum wages in EUR and PPS, half-yearly).

compare.description: For energy-prices and minimum-wages: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL) to compare with Poland, default DE.

topic.description: house-prices: Eurostat index. mortgage-rates: ECB rates on new housing loans. bond-yields: 10-year yields and spreads. overburden and overcrowding: housing conditions. energy-prices: household electricity or gas. minimum-wages: statutory minimum wages.
